ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 2:3 ratio of high-intensity white/off-white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Symmetric dark central region extending from the peduncle, flanked by large white contiguous regions on the lateral lobes. The white regions are interrupted by dark, vertically and horizontally oriented linear streaks and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrated boundary with irregular peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex trailing edge curve with sharp distal tips; slight concavity observed immediately adjacent to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized cluster of high-intensity white circular nodes on the upper distal tip of the right lobe; scattered white circular spots on the dark central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark linear 'X' intersection located in the upper-middle region of the right lobe; multiple parallel white horizontal linear markings (rake marks) on the lower region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark cross-shaped scar on the right lobe; multiple white rake marks on the left lobe; potential barnacle colonization at the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The geometric 'X' pattern on the right lobe provides a highly unique visual identifier within the pixel field.
